headline: Mitsotakis on public debt: early repayment of €13 billion in 2026 – a national success beyond partisan pettiness
summary: Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis said Greece is leaving behind its status as the most heavily indebted state on the continent. He cited early repayment of €13 billion in 2026.
why: Public debt levels and early repayments shape a sovereign's borrowing costs and credit standing, which feed into government bond yields and the wider Greek economy.
